source.author: verg
source.text: Ferrum exercebant vasto Cyclopes in antro, Brontesque Steropesque et nudus membra Pyragmon.
source.text_original: Ferrum exercebant vasto Cyclopes in antro, / Brontesque Steropesque et nudus membra Pyragmon.
source.text_english: The Cyclopes were working the iron in the vast cave, Brontes and Steropes and Pyraemon bare in limb.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: illam Acamans habitat nudusque Pyragmon, has nimbi ventique domos et naufraga servat tempestas.
reuse.text_original: illam Acamans habitat nudusque Pyragmon, / has nimbi ventique domos et naufraga servat / tempestas.
reuse.text_english: Acamans dwells in that place, and naked Pyragmon too; these homes are preserved by storms and winds and by shipwrecking tempest.
